status: partial backend and stdio implementation; no independent acceptance

observe.source_field: RFC6901 JSON pointer into case-local artifact snapshot; ~0/~1 supported and array indexes canonical ASCII decimals only
observe.raw_values: Exact JSON strings for all supported types; exact integers additionally for app-id/account. No numeric coercion, case folding, normalization or automatic association. Booleans/null/floats unsupported.
observe.provenance: Original artifact ID/evidence/file/source reference/parser/logical path/source hash plus immutable bounded artifact snapshot and its hash, preserving original labels/profile/source tier.

merge.limits: 2–32 distinct case-local observation IDs; confirmed must be JSON true
merge.meaning: Examiner-asserted relationship; not authenticated personal identity.

split.meaning: Withdraws one active merge assertion, retaining all history and original observations. Other active assertions can still connect these observations transitively. Reassociation requires a new merge.

limits.behavior: Reject before append or response materialization when capacity exceeded; explicit error, never silent truncation.

integrity: Audit chain checked before reads and writes; serialized append; no update/delete API. Local chain is not immutable or signed storage. Snapshots survive reparsing; source artifacts/conversation IDs never rewritten.
pending: Independent schema-specific acceptance and examiner workflow review
Authenticated identity/authority and signed retention are not implemented
No automatic graph propagation into findings, conversations or customer reports
Source snapshots reference imported artifacts; association is not independent source authenticity proof
